summary.text: A purpose-built freshwater diving pool in Dubai, certified as the deepest in the world at about 60 m, used for scuba and freediving training and exploring a sunken-city set.

s1.quote: As you reach the island, the depth drops to 3-8 metres on most sides. … Visibility is generally 5-15 metres; it improves through the cooler months … From Sandy Beach Hotel & Resort it is a 5-10 minute swim out to the island. … Snoopy itself is the easiest entry-level shore dive in the country.
